object.attr: derived: MELLON-TRACE-SRS-96 works states out again only on activation, so a commit an agent makes while the user watches the window leaves OK on screen for links that turned suspect (CF-T58). Answered on 2026-11-10. The value waits for MELLON-TRACE-SRS-111 to be measured.
object.description: When the latest commit moves while a Document Editor is active, the Document Editor shall show the link states at the new latest commit within TBD s.
